body:
Full session lifecycle client (new-session/navigate-to/find-element/element-click/element-send-keys/element-text/page-title/quit-session) built on this session's net/http.prn+json.prn. Real Selenium bindings ARE a JSON-over-HTTP WebDriver-protocol client, not FFI to a browser engine -- no libselenium exists, matches how every official Selenium client library actually works. Added json/get+as-string (json.prn only had parse()) and new stdlib/process.prn (process-spawn/process-kill, real fork+exec FFI, founder: 'wrap it in parena ffi if possible') for the test harness's own fixture-server lifecycle -- caught and fixed the same libc-name-collision bug class as net/tcp's rename (plain kill collides with signal.h). Real e2e verification: tests/test_webdriver.c runs the full lifecycle against tests/fake_webdriver_server.go (real Go HTTP server standing in for a real driver -- Go not Python per founder real-time), spawned/killed via real PARENA FFI, not shell scripting. 13/13 checks pass. make test 336/336 green. Honest limit: no real chromedriver/browser installed, so only the wire protocol is live-verified, not actual browser rendering. PARENA commit 7737712.

⚓ ☃
title: Real WebDriver-protocol client -- Selenium bindings (stdlib/net/webdriver.prn)
